assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument does not contain separate dedicated questions to measure unpaid domestic or care work for each person. Domestic and care activities are only mentioned as reasons for not attending school (Pregunta 9), reasons for not being available/desiring to work additional hours (Pregunta 29a), categories of inactivity (Pregunta 36: 'Ama de casa?'), or occupational status categories (Pregunta 42: 'Trabajador del hogar No Remunerado?'). Consequently, domestic work cannot be distinguished from main and secondary employment through individual questions devoted to domestic/care activities.
